name: Webform Sanitize Submissions
description: Webform handler that deletes selected element values from stored submissions after processing.
project_description:
This module provides a Webform handler that allows submission data of certain form elements to not be stored in the database. The submission data can still be used in other handlers preceding the Sanitize submission handler.

 Post-Installation 
 After installing the module, add the Webform handler to your webform. Whether or not a certain element needs to be sanitized from submissions needs to be configured when editing that element. You'll find the Sanitize element value toggle under the Advanced tab.

 Similar projects 
 
 The Webform Sanitize module has similar functionality, but it doesn't sanitize submissions automatically and all of its configuration is on one separate page instead of being integrated with the Webform UI.
